core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aafaq corresponds to the Arabic form آفاق (Arabic root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q); آفَاق (Āfāq)). Its core sense is horizons, far regions. Aafaq is Arabic آفَاق (Āfāq) 'horizons, far regions', the plural of أُفُق (ufuq), from the root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q). The source gloss 'Heavens' is broadly consistent. Same name as aafak.

urdu.name: آفاق
urdu.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم آفاق، کنارے، دور دراز علاقے ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: آفاق
persian.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن آفاق، کرانه‌ها است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आफ़ाक़

arabic.name: آفاق
arabic.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الْآفَاق، النَّوَاحِي. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Aafaq is associated with the Arabic form آفاق, whose core sense is horizons, far regions.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aafaq?
faq.a: Aafaq is associated with Arabic. Aafaq is Arabic آفَاق (Āfāq) 'horizons, far regions', the plural of أُفُق (ufuq), from the root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q). The source gloss 'Heavens' is broadly consistent. Same name as aafak.
Yes — the underlying form آفاق is Arabic.
Aafaq can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Aafaq mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aafaq is rendered آفاق and carries the sense آفاق، کنارے، دور دراز علاقے.

faq.q: What does Aafaq mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Aafaq is rendered آفاق and carries the sense آفاق، کرانه‌ها.
A romanized syllable approximation is aa-faq. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aafaq?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aafaq, aafaq, afaq. Script forms are آفاق, आफ़ाक़.

faq.q: Is Aafaq a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
